open_points.subject: flow activation authorization
open_points.text: K-11 calls activate one of “the owner's approve, accept, activate, grant, revoke, resolve and cancel”, while the primary action, A06 and flow:compose_prove_activate_flow allow an agent to request activation of a proven read-only version.
open_points.question: May an agent invoke the activate-flow surface operation for a proven read-only version, or is activation invocation owner-only?
options: An agent may request activation only for a proven read-only version; the kernel records the activation.
Only the owner may invoke activation, including for read-only versions.
open_points.default_guess: Allow an agent to request activation of a proven read-only version, following A06 and the reviewed flow.

open_points.subject: OperationBinding identity creation
open_points.text: State 3 says `store` keeps “minted identities”, but flow:propose_and_accept_binding says “module:bindings ... mints binding_id (A01 rule 2)” before writing the binding.
open_points.question: Which module owns random generation and collision handling for `binding_id`?
options: `store` mints and collision-checks the identifier inside `record_change`.
`bindings` mints the identifier and passes it to `store` for insertion.
open_points.default_guess: Have `store` mint and collision-check `binding_id` atomically inside the binding write.
